# HAProxy — custom-to-root-context-servlet-mapping

Proxy at /app/ui/, app at root / with VAADIN_URL_MAPPING=/ui/*. Two translations at once: /app/ui/HILLA and /app/ui/connect lose both segments because Hilla lives at the context root, while everything else loses only /app. The rules are ordered most specific first, so the general strip cannot fire on a path the Hilla rule already rewrote.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/http/custom-to-root-context-servlet-mapping/vaadin.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# Proxy at /app/ui/, app at the backend root with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*.
# Two translations at once, and the order of the two rewrite rules is the whole
# scenario.
#
# Hilla lives at the context root whatever vaadin.url-mapping says, so
# /app/ui/HILLA/* and /app/ui/connect/* lose both segments, while everything
# else — /app/ui/* for the Vaadin servlet including /ui/VAADIN/push, and the
# root-level resources /VAADIN/*, /sw.js, /styles.css, /manifest.webmanifest,
# /icons/*, /images/*, /test-redirect — loses only /app. See vaadin/hilla#289.
#
# Getting this subtly wrong yields a working app with a dead Hilla Flux, which
# the suite only catches when it runs with it.websocket=true.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80

    acl is_app path /app
    acl is_app path_beg /app/
    http-request deny deny_status 404 unless is_app

    # Most specific first. `replace-path` rules are evaluated in order, and once
    # this one has rewritten /app/ui/HILLA/... the general strip below no longer
    # matches it — no condition needed to keep them apart.
    http-request replace-path ^/app/ui(/(HILLA|connect)/.*) \1
    http-request replace-path ^/app/?(.*) /\1

    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    http-response replace-header Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/(.*) \1/app/\2
    # Anchored on the end of the value: Tomcat writes `Path=/; HttpOnly`, and a
    # regex expecting another path segment after the slash matches nothing.
    http-response replace-header Set-Cookie (.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/(;.*)?$ \1/app\2
    server vaadin vaadin:8080
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
